revenue.source: CAT FY2025 10-K (cat-20251231.htm) MD&A: total sales and revenues $67.589B/64.809B/67.060B

d_and_a.source: Cash flow statement: FY2025 4Q earnings release (8-K ex99.1, 2026-01-29) 2,262/2,153; FY2024 10-K Financial_Report 2,144 for 2023

capex.source: Cash flow: capex excl. leased equipment (1,597/1,988/2,821) + expenditures for equipment leased to others (1,495/1,227/1,465); FY2025 10-K and 4Q25 release

revenue_growth.source: Analyst assumption: FY2025 grew 4%; rebound from tariff/volume headwinds and power/data-center demand tapering to near-nominal GDP growth. Not company guidance.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 16.5% (11,151/67,589), FY2024 20.2%, FY2023 19.3%; mid-cycle blend with modest recovery.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. US statutory 21% plus state/foreign; not taken from a filing's effective rate.

capex_pct_revenue.source: FY2025 capex incl. leased equipment 4,286/67,589 = 6.3%; FY2023-24 about 4.8%; assume 5.8% in between.

wacc.source: Assumption: beta ~1.0-1.1, risk-free ~4.2%, ERP ~5%, with debt weight including Cat Financial; ~9% rounded. Not computed from provider data.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal GDP/inflation, below WACC.

net_debt.source: 4Q25 release balance sheet 12/31/2025: short-term borrowings 5,514 + LT debt due within one year (35+7,085) + LT debt due after one year 30,696 = 43,330, less cash 9,980. Consolidated incl. Financial Products debt; no short-term investments found. Reviewer may prefer ME&T-only.

diluted_shares.source: 4Q25 earnings release: weighted-average diluted shares, twelve months 2025, 472.3 million
